time_base: Event times are video times. Review frames were extracted at 1 fps with ffmpeg's fps filter, which samples t = N + 0.5 s; every evidence frame below was re-extracted at the exact time in 'frames' (seconds) and verified against the reviewed frame. File names use the floor second (t<mmss>).
